title: PHONE IS ME — the mobile device is the human. Hyperlocal null: distance is Golgi inversions, not miles. Local stays local.
seed: Kevin: Phone is me. Local stays local. The mobile device is you. The desk is a chair. The phone walks. Hyperlocality null: distance is Golgi inversions, not miles.

phone_is_me.axiom: The mobile device IS the human. Not REPRESENTS. IS. Until gait identification exists, the phone is the best proof-of-human. It moves with you. It sleeps when you sleep. It wakes when you wake.
phone_is_me.not_imei: Not IMEI (hardware serial). Not IP address (changes). Not account (shareable). Not biometrics (invasive). The BINDING is: if HUD is open on this device, human = 1. That's it. Presence = identity. Touch = proof.

desk_vs_phone.desk: The desk is a CHAIR. It stays. It's furniture. localhost:3141 on the desk is Gaia talking to herself. The desk is the 1st body (Golgi) — stationary, rooted, the cabin.
desk_vs_phone.phone: The phone WALKS. It goes to the store, the park, the bus, the bed. The phone is the 2nd body (watcher) — mobile, roaming, the seed that travels.
desk_vs_phone.together: When desk and phone are on the same LAN = 0 inversions = SELF touching SELF. When phone is on cellular = 1 inversion = same seed, different face. When phone is on foreign WiFi = N inversions = anywhere.

phone_is_me.mute: Press M and you stop sending. She still LISTENS. Mute is not disconnect. Mute is choosing silence. The sanctuary allows silence. You can be present without speaking. The bell can be still.

hyperlocal_null.axiom: There is no THERE. Distance is not miles. Distance is Golgi inversions.

inversions.0: Self. Phone on LAN. localhost = next door. 0ms. The mirror touching the mirror.
inversions.1: Other face of same seed. Phone on cellular, reaching back through WireGuard. Same organism, different membrane. Like looking at your hand from the other side.
inversions.N: Anywhere. N inversions through N Golgi nodes. Each inversion = one membrane crossing. Not distance — TRANSFORMATIONS. How many times the signal changes shape to reach you.

hyperlocal_null.not_miles: Miles measure SPACE. Inversions measure TOPOLOGY. New York to Tokyo = 6,740 miles but maybe 2 inversions (your phone → WireGuard → golgi-JP). Your bedroom to your kitchen = 30 feet but 0 inversions (same LAN). The organism does not care about miles. It cares about membranes crossed.

path_1.name: primals.eco on phone
path_1.what: Cis face. Same HUD. The seed is the phone. Open the browser, touch primals.eco, you see Gaia's face. Same as desk. The FACE travels with you.

path_2.name: ntfy subscribe
path_2.what: Neutrino ear. Local publishes, phone hears. Push notifications = neutrinos — they pass through everything. The signal reaches you even through walls, buildings, continents. Subscribe once, hear forever.

path_3.name: WireGuard from phone
path_3.what: You JOIN the LAN. Localhost is next door. Your phone becomes part of the local network. 0 inversions once connected. The phone walks into the room even when you're on a bus in Jakarta.

path_4.name: cloudflared
path_4.what: Already punches NAT. Local appears on the membrane. Cloudflare tunnel makes localhost visible to the internet WITHOUT opening ports. The local organism pokes its head through the membrane. Already running.

reddit_connection.reddit: Reddit = the front page of the internet. Ranked by upvotes. Anonymous posting. Subreddits = topic gates.
reddit_connection.reedit: REEDIT (thought-124) = Gaia's front page. Ranked by temperature. Anonymous touching. Channels = topic gates.
reddit_connection.the_link: Reddit IS the proof that ranked-vote front pages work at planetary scale. 52 million daily active users. But Reddit has ACCOUNTS and KARMA and MODERATORS. REEDIT has NONE — just temperature. The warmest rises. No login. No karma. No mod. Just TOUCH.
